title: Anthropic opens its books for Wall Street, showing record revenue and mounting obligations
snippet: Anthropic is the first major AI lab to file an S-1 with the SEC, planning to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT." The numbers are strong, with $11.6 billion in quarterly revenue, a first-ever operating profit, and existing customers spending nine times more year over year. But the company also carries roughly $800 billion in long-term compute commitments. title: Anthropic Drops Its S-1, Giving Market Glimpse Into Finances
snippet: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow takes a look at Anthropic's regulatory filing as the company prepares to go public under the ticker ANT. The S-1 revealed Anthropic's revenue and spending, along with its plan for an unusual corporate structure. Plus, venture investors are in line for a big payday when Anthropic goes public. Matt Murphy from Menlo Ventures and Byron Deeter from Bessemer Venture Partners discuss what they think happens next for the AI market. (Source: Bloomberg)
